listing.name: Lobster Proliferation 4.2.0 (0.97a)
listing.summary: Adds lobsters into the commodity economy. If you used any 3.X.X or lower version of the mod (for 0.96 and earlier), it's unfortunately not save compatible (lul), so youll have to start a new save (4.0.0 and above are all compatible and save compatible with each other!). I changed the whole implementation of it to be more futureproof, it might be compatible with tasc now I dunno.
